---
title: "Maintain the Reader's Guide Evidence"
subtitle: "Rebuild the comparison figures and validate their scope"
execute:
  eval: false
engine: markdown
---

Operators maintain the national summaries embedded in the
[reader's guide](00_data-guide.qmd). These procedures require the governed
workspace and saved pipeline outputs.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Use the Governed Evidence Workspace"}

Confirm access to the frozen May 2025 archive and the saved pipeline products
used by `scripts/build-data-guide.R`. Review the source boundary and the
existing figure provenance before regenerating the evidence.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Reproduce the Evidence Without Rebuilding the Pipeline"}

The figures are generated explicitly from saved outputs. Rendering the Manual
only embeds the precomputed national summaries; it never reads research data.
Run from the repository root in an appropriate compute allocation:

```sh
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript scripts/build-data-guide.R prepare
uv run --no-project --with pyarrow==22.0.0 python scripts/read-guide-archive.py
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript scripts/build-data-guide.R plot
```

The pinned Python reader is used only to project the frozen Feather reference;
it is not a dependency of the scientific R pipeline. Diagnostic projections,
monthly aggregates, dictionary differences, and keyed comparisons remain under
ignored `data/intermediates/data-guide/`. The versioned
[figure provenance](assets/data-guide/provenance.json) records the archive,
reference member, saved output, script hashes, and comparison snapshot. Rebuild
this evidence after changing the saved pipeline products, then review the
snapshot text and figures before rerendering.

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Verify Comparisons and Review the Claim"}

Run the synthetic diagnostics and the Manual structure check:

```sh
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript tests/check-data-guide.R
python3 tests/check-manual-structure.py
```

Review the resulting figures, provenance, and snapshot text together.
Agreement for three example series does not establish all-variable
scientific equivalence. Keep unmatched clinic-months, missing values,
sentinels, and source-boundary coverage differences explicit in the guide.

:::
